A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the effects of Trk receptor activation are context dependent and that the context of a given cell may vary even among cells of the same lineage.
the actions of neurotrophin receptors can be context-dependent.
Trk receptors are not simply on-off switches, but rather that they are complex signaling machines that are regulated in part by the cell context in the environment in which they reside.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the regulatory effects of Trk activation are not fixed, but can vary with differences between cells in the context in which the Trk receptors are expressed.
neurotrophin actions on neuronal excitability are not necessarily obligatory for the regulation of neuronal phenotype.

neurotrophins do not have a fixed set of actions that are obligatory in all target cells, but rather that the effects of neurotrophic signaling on cell phenotype depend on the cell context of receptor activation.
